 PSG W vs PSG W – Head-to-head record
 Bayern have enjoyed the upper hand in their recent meetings with PSG , particularly when playing in the French capital. The German side won their last two away matches against the Parisians, including a 3-1 victory in last season’s Champions League league phase.
 PSG’s most memorable European home success against Bayern came in March 2017, when they secured a 4-0 victory in the second leg of a quarter-final tie. However, the hosts will need to produce a similarly impressive performance to end Bayern’s recent dominance in this fixture.
 PSG W – Strong home form despite injury concerns
 Paris Saint-Germain have made an encouraging start to their Champions League campaign, collecting five points from their opening three matches. Let’s take a look at their momentum and the expected PSG W vs. Bayern Munich W lineups.
 Recent form
 PSG began their European campaign with a 1-1 draw away to Real Madrid before recording an emphatic 5-0 home victory over OH Leuven. They subsequently earned another point against Manchester City, with Tara Elimbi scoring an 88th-minute equaliser after Bunny Shaw had put the English side ahead from the penalty spot.
 Paulo Cesar’s team have also been consistent domestically . After drawing 1-1 against local rivals Paris FC, they returned to winning ways with a convincing 4-0 victory over Le Havre on Friday, leaving them second in the Premiere Ligue table.
 That result extended PSG’s impressive home record: they have won five of their last six competitive matches at home without conceding. Nevertheless, Bayern represent a considerably tougher challenge, and the hosts will need to cope with several important absences.
 PSG will be without Anais Ebayilin, who is expected to miss the remainder of the season after suffering an anterior cruciate ligament injury. Rasheedat Ajibade is also unavailable with a leg fracture, while Sakina Karchaoui faces a six-to-eight-week absence after injuring her ankle against Manchester City.

 Bayern Munich W – Unbeaten run inspires confidence
 Let’s now turn our attention to Bayern Munich W. We will analyse the team’s momentum and recent results ahead of this match.
 Recent form
 The German champions opened their European campaign with a 2-2 draw against Manchester City before recording a convincing 3-0 victory away to Benfica. They then recovered from two goals down to earn another 2-2 draw against Real Madrid.
 Since that European encounter, Bayern have returned to winning ways with victories over Bayer Leverkusen in the DFB-Pokal Frauen and Werder Bremen in the Frauen-Bundesliga.
 Those results extended their unbeaten start to the season to 15 matches, comprising 13 wins and two draws. Bayern have not lost a competitive fixture since their 4-2 defeat against Barcelona in the second leg of last season’s Champions League semi-final.
 Jose Barcala’s side will also take confidence from their recent away record against PSG, having won their last two visits to the French capital. However, they will be without Glodis Perla Viggosdottir and Lena Oberdorf, who are both sidelined with knee injuries.

 Predictions for PSG W vs Bayern Munich W – Bayern to Claim an Away Victory
 Both teams have shown considerable attacking quality in recent weeks, while Bayern have scored regularly throughout their unbeaten run. With the visitors expected to take the initiative, we could see goals before and after half-time .
 Bayern have made a habit of starting matches strongly, and their attacking options give them the potential to establish an early advantage. That makes Bayern leading at half-time an alternative worth considering.
 PSG have been difficult to beat, particularly at home, but their injury problems could undermine their chances. Bayern Munich’s excellent start to the season makes them a strong candidate to take all three points in Paris .
